properties.areaDesc: Mineral, CO; Rio Grande, CO
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 24 at 6:02PM MDT until October 24 at 8:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues along the Rio Grande and downstream
waterways.

* WHERE...Southeastern Mineral County and Rio Grande County...

* WHEN...Until 815 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding will continue along and near the Rio Grande this
evening, especially from near Del Norte to below Monte Vista.
Several roads remain closed and housing areas evacuated due to high
water. While many rivers and streams have already crested, flooding
and high flows will continue this evening, especially around Monte
Vista.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 553 PM MDT, Water levels along the Rio Grande remain high,
especially in the stretch from Del Norte to below Monte Vista,
although the river has crested and levels are forecast to remain
steady or slowly fall into evening.
- Highway 285 between Monte Vista and Center remains closed, as
well as Highway 112 between Del Norte and Center and Highway 160
between Wolf Creek Pass and South Fork. Please continue to heed
any road closures.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
The Rio Grande from Del Norte to Monte Vista.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 815 PM MDT THIS EVENING

properties.description:

miles northeast of Ruidoso, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Trained spotters reported.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 24 at 6:00PM MDT until October 24 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
At 600 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 12 miles northeast
of Acala, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of west
central Hudspeth County.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Prepare immediately for large hail and damaging winds. People outside
should move to a shelter, inside a strong building and away from
windows.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 630 PM MDT FOR WEST CENTRAL HUDSPETH COUNTY

properties.areaDesc: Yavapai, AZ
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 24 at 4:55PM MST until October 24 at 6:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 455 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated that heavy rain has ended over
the warned area, including the Sycamore Creek drainage, around 10
miles east of Cordes Junction. Between 1 and 2.25 inches of rain have
fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Dugas and Cedar Bench Wilderness.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Agua Fria River, Sycamore Creek, Little Ash Creek, Indian Creek,
Bishop Creek, Cold Water Creek, Chasm Creek, Silver Creek, South
Prong Sycamore Creek, Gap Creek, Dry Creek and Little Sycamore
Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 645 PM MST THIS EVENING FOR YAVAPAI COUNTY

properties.areaDesc: Hudspeth, TX
properties.senderName: NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 24 at 5:46PM MDT until October 24 at 8:45PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
FFWEPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Hudspeth County in western Texas...

* Until 845 PM MDT.

* At 546 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Acala.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.areaDesc: Cibola, NM; McKinley, NM
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 24 at 5:37PM MDT until October 24 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 537 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across the warned area. Up to 3.5 inches of rain have fallen.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Laguna Pueblo, Skyline-Ganipa, Acoma Pueblo, San Fidel, Cubero,
McCartys, New Laguna, Cebolletita and San Mateo.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 92 and 114.
properties.instruction:
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly or mountainous terrain there are numerous low water
crossings which are potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 PM MDT THIS EVENING FOR EASTERN CIBOLA AND EAST CENTRAL MCKINLEY COUNTIES

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 24 at 5:36PM MDT until October 24 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
SVREPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South central Sierra County in south central New Mexico...
Northeastern Dona Ana County in south central New Mexico...

* Until 615 PM MDT.

* At 535 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 12 miles northeast
of Radium Springs, moving northeast at 25 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Portions of Jornada Experimental Range.
